svg.title: UCP Platform Client - Request Pattern, Checkout Flow and Lifecycle
svg.text: UCP Platform Client — Request Pattern, Checkout Flow & Lifecycle
Every store call goes through call_mcp(merchant, tool, args) · each store has its own cart and checkout · one checkout open at a time · payment switched off · updated 2026-10-23
Request pattern — call_mcp(merchant, tool, args): every store call, from the chat or an /api/mcp/* endpoint
chat: the store tag on the
Failures are isolated per store: when several stores are searched, one store's failure becomes a notice and the other stores' results still come back.
Checkout flow — one store at a time (each store owns its cart, checkout and payment)
• One checkout open at a time: starting one at another store is refused until it is finished or cancelled.
• Changing a store's cart closes that store's open checkout; the next checkout starts from the new cart.
• A cart or checkout the store reports as not found is dropped; the next add starts a new cart.
• A shipping address country overrides the profile's country in the checkout context.
• cancel_checkout also drops the cart when the store closed it together with the checkout.
Checkout status lifecycle (UCP spec) — where this client stops
This client stops at ready_for_complete, because payment is off. Pier 1 checkouts stay in
requires_escalation (extension_interaction_required): a checkout extension on the store needs
the buyer on the store's own page, which would be the continue_url hand-off.
MCP arguments sent on every call
// then the tool's own arguments, one of:
// update_checkout, with "id"; a full replacement every time
"id": "<cart or checkout id>" // get_* and cancel_*
context and signals come from the chat session; the direct /api/mcp/* endpoints pass their request bodies through as given.
Direct endpoints → MCP tool (every endpoint takes ?merchant=<id>, default pier1)
Chat: POST /api/chat and /api/checkout/details → agent.py → shop.py → the same call_mcp pattern.
Discovery: GET /profile.json (our platform profile) · GET /api/merchants · GET /api/health · GET /api/exchanges.
Errors: unknown store 404 · unavailable store 503 · UCP error 404 (not found) or 422 · transport failure 502.
